title: fix(checkout): restore the 15 s gateway timeout; a timeout never fails an order
summary: Restored GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS to 15 s, and a gateway timeout now leaves the order PENDING for reconciliation instead of FAILED. Added two regression tests from the incident: a 4-second UPI confirmation completes the order, and a timeout never fails one. All 4 tests pass.

steps.text: Reading the incident: 19 customers report payments that hang and then fail, often after their bank debited them. It started after checkout-service v4.21.7.
Release v4.21.7 cut the gateway timeout from 15 seconds to 1.5. UPI and card confirmations take 2 to 8 seconds, so checkout gives up and marks the order failed while the bank still takes the money.
That explains all three symptoms: the pay button that spins, "debited but order failed", and customers retrying and being charged again. Writing a test that reproduces it before touching the code.
Reproduced: both new tests fail on v4.21.7. The fix: restore the 15 s timeout, and treat a timeout as PENDING, so a slow confirmation can never fail an order the bank has charged.

steps.replace:
* UPI and 3-D Secure confirmations routinely take 2 to 8 seconds, so failing
 * fast fails payments the bank has already captured (INC-2026-001).
 */
export const GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

steps.find: import { authorize, type Gateway, type PaymentRequest } from "../payments/gateway.ts";
steps.replace: import { authorize, GatewayTimeout, type Gateway, type PaymentRequest } from "../payments/gateway.ts";

steps.text: All 4 tests pass. The change is two lines of behaviour plus the regression tests; nothing else in checkout is touched.
